file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for University of Southampton BM5 BMBS A100. This file preserves the user-supplied Southampton research document, evidence classifications, implementation mapping and known review boundaries; executable rules live in data/universities/southampton-a100.json.

research_scope.primary_policy_cycle: 2025/26 and forward where stated in the research
research_scope.historical_guidance_cycle: 2024 entry FOI UCAT thresholds on legacy 3600 scale, displayed only in their original scale
research_scope.evidence_intake_basis: /Users/faizan/Desktop/medical university research/Southampton/Southampton.docx supplied by the user on 2026-07-14
research_scope.notes: The existing repository profile was an MSC seed with unknown rules. It has been replaced with the approved research-backed production profile.

evidence_classification_policy.official: A rule or statistic attributed by the supplied research to a first-party University of Southampton, UCAS, MSC or Office for Students source.
evidence_classification_policy.foi_verified_historical_guidance: A cycle-labelled admissions statistic or threshold attributed to Freedom of Information evidence in the supplied research.
evidence_classification_policy.legacy_3600_historical_figure: A legacy 3600-scale UCAT score from a pre-2025 admissions cycle; displayed only in its original scale and not compared directly with current 2700-scale applicant scores.
evidence_classification_policy.historical_guidance: A past-cycle observation used to position interview competitiveness, never as a current guarantee.
evidence_classification_policy.unknown: The supplied evidence does not establish the fact safely enough for execution.
evidence_classification_policy.intake_caveat: The user designated the completed Southampton research document as authoritative. Source classifications preserve its evidence log and caveats.

metadata.architecture_change_summary: A generic opt-in graduate GCSE gate was added so courses can require GCSE eligibility for graduate A100 applicants while waiving A-levels.
metadata.repository_discrepancy_reported_before_e: Existing Southampton A100 production JSON was a low-confidence MSC seed with unknown GCSE, A-level, UCAT and shortlisting rules; the production implementation replaces it with the approved research-backed UCAT-only model.

route_limited_blockers: Southampton sets UCAT interview thresholds dynamically after the UCAS deadline, so future thresholds cannot be predicted deterministically.

Historical Home UCAT threshold evidence from 2021-2024 is on the previous 3600-point UCAT scale; ApplySmart uses documented 2700-scale conversions only for modelling guidance, not as official Southampton cut-offs.
Country-specific international qualification equivalences are not tabulated in the supplied research.
The Selection Day numerical rubric and offer score cut-off are not published.
Graduate BM5 A100 UCAT threshold data is not published separately in the supplied research.
engine_execution_boundaries: Country-specific international qualifications require Southampton-verified equivalence evidence.
Advanced Higher case-by-case Scottish profiles require manual review outside the executable Higher AAAAB route.
Alternative English language evidence and exemptions require verification unless represented by declared exemption evidence.
Non-standard resit sequences beyond the configured one-attempt rule require manual review.
readiness.summary: Official and FOI-labelled evidence supports scoped BM5 A100 eligibility and pool-specific UCAT interview guidance for Home and International applicants.

course_identity.medical_school: University of Southampton School of Medicine
course_identity.course_name: BM5 Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (BMBS)
course_identity.graduate_places: No separate A100 graduate sub-allocation; BM4 A101 has its own quota.

steps: Require UCAT in the year of application.
Rank eligible applicants by UCAT cognitive total only within separate Home and International pools.
Do not use GCSE scoring, academic ranking, SJT scoring, personal statement scoring or guaranteed interview routes.

gcse.minimum_profile: 7 GCSEs at Grade B / 6 or above, including English Language, Mathematics and Sciences.
gcse.science: Biology and Chemistry at Grade B / 6 if taking triple science, or Combined Science / Double Award at 6-6 / BB.

a_level.contextual: AAB for verified Home fee-paying school-leavers meeting at least two contextual flags
a_level.subject_rule: Biology plus one of Chemistry, Physics, Psychology, Sociology, Environmental Studies or Geography.
a_level.resits: One retake attempt per A-level, maximum three subjects, all A-level resits in the same sitting.

international_baccalaureate.standard: 36 points overall with 18 points at Higher Level, including Grade 6 in HL Biology and Grade 6 in one additional accepted HL science.
international_baccalaureate.contextual: No contextual IB reduction is published for BM5 A100.
international_baccalaureate.standard_level_english: Grade 5 if needed for baseline English.
international_baccalaureate.standard_level_maths: Grade 5 if needed for baseline Maths.

scottish.standard: AAAAB Highers by the end of S5, including Biology and one additional accepted science; National 5 English and Maths at B / 6 or above.
scottish.advanced_higher: Considered case-by-case as part of the S6 curriculum.

graduate_a100.requirement: Upper Second-Class Honours (2:1) in the first degree.
graduate_a100.a_level_requirement: Waived for graduate applicants to BM5 A100.

english_language.ielts: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with 7.0 in Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.
documented_exemptions: GCSE or IGCSE English Language grade B / 6 or above
GCE O-Level English Language or Cambridge International O-Level English grade C or above
Majority English-speaking country exemption where accepted
Degree taught and assessed entirely in English for at least 2 academic years with official university letter

home_threshold.notes: The supplied research describes approximately 2100+ as expected competitive guidance for Home applicants under the current 2700-scale UCAT format. It is not a published fixed cut-off.

rules.condition: academically eligible Home applicant with UCAT below 1900
academically eligible Home applicant with UCAT 1900 to 2199 inclusive
academically eligible Home applicant with UCAT 2200 or above

applysmart_home_band_model.rationale: The 2200 Strong boundary is above the highest available converted historical Home threshold and 100 points above the approximate 2100 current-format Home competitive guidance. It is an ApplySmart modelling boundary, not an official Southampton cut-off.

international_threshold.notes: No verified current 2700-scale International BM5 A100 UCAT guidance figure is represented in the supplied research.

historical_context.warning: Historical UCAT thresholds are guidance only and must never be presented as guaranteed future cut-offs.

interview_format.format: Selection Day with panel interview and observed group task
interview_format.duration: Approximately 40-60 minutes total: 20-30 minute panel interview plus 20-30 minute group task.
domains: Understanding the values of the NHS Constitution

international_policy.english_language_profile: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall and 7.0 in each component, or verified exemption

contextual_and_widening_participation.notes: BM6 A102 has separate widening-participation rules and is excluded from BM5 A100 execution.

tie_break_sequence: Total UCAT score for identical interview scores
offer_selection_research.personal_statement_used: Not for shortlisting; read by interviewers as a Selection Day discussion prompt.

evidence_gaps.description: Future UCAT thresholds are not known before each admissions cycle's applicant pool is ranked.
evidence_gaps.impact: Prediction can only use labelled historical guidance.

evidence_gaps.description: The 2021-2024 FOI Home thresholds are on the old 3600 scale.
evidence_gaps.impact: Converted 2700-scale equivalents may calibrate ApplySmart modelling boundaries, but they are not official Southampton current cut-offs or eligibility minima.

evidence_gaps.description: Country-specific equivalence tables are referenced but not tabulated in the approved research.
evidence_gaps.impact: Unlisted international qualifications require verified equivalence evidence.

evidence_gaps.description: Southampton does not publish the numerical Selection Day rubric or offer score cut-off.
evidence_gaps.impact: Offer prediction remains out of scope.
